title: Freelancing in the 1960s
summary: He freelanced around New Jersey and did no other work.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: In other words, what I'm trying to do here is fill in the gaps during most of the Sixties, when you were just freelancing, I guess, and playing jobs here and there.
Did you take any other work outside of music to sort of fill up your time or help your income? Did you do any work for the studios? Did you do any recording in the studios?
No, I don't think I did. I know after... I was doing some freelancing stuff. I don't think I did anything else for a while.
